IMPORTANT: This program provides supplemental health insurance only. It does not provide basic medical, or comprehensive/major medical
coverage, and does not satisfy the “minimum essential coverage” requirements of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.
This HarborSTM Health Insurance Plan does not qualify as the minimum essential coverage required by the Affordable Care Act (ACA). Benefits not
available in all states at this time. Members can be enrolled only once. Duplicate or multiple memberships are not allowed. Coverage is not provided for
members age 65 or over, coverage will terminate at the end of the month insured turns age 65. If coverage is canceled, persons may not re-enroll in
coverage with Everest Reinsurance Company until six months after their termination date.
States may vary. 
Short Term Medical insurance is often a lower-cost alternative to COBRA. However, if you purchase Short Term Medical rather than maintaining COBRA
coverage, you may give up your rights to coverage for pre-existing conditions or guaranteed health insurance in the future. Short Term Medical benefits
may be limited compared to COBRA coverage.
*The Cigna Healthcare PPO Network refers to the health care providers (doctors, hospitals, specialists) contracted as part of the Cigna Healthcare PPO for
Shared Administration.
Plan Highlights
Deductible Options 
Preventive Care
Predictable Copays
Pre-Existing Conditions Rider 
Choose from four deductibles options - $2,500, $5,000, $7,500 or $10,000 to
meet your needs and budget. Lower deductible plans can limit your out of
pocket exposure while choosing a higher deductible plan
can save on monthly premiums.
Preventive care is crucial to your overall health and wellbeing. HarborSTM
features one annual wellness visit included on all plan options.
Harbor Access and Secure plans offer a predictable $40 copay for doctor
office and urgent care visits. This is the amount you’ll pay to the provider at
the time of your service.
HarborSTM plans offer an optional pre-existing conditions rider. If the rider
is selected and a health condition arises during the initial policy, that
condition would not be excluded as pre-existing in the subsequent policy. 
American Workers Association (AWA) membership provides access to the Harbor 
short term medical plan in select states. Review association benefits for details.

The Pre-Existing Conditions Rider is an optional add-on and is not available in all states. Not available in Ohio (OH).
Short-term medical insurance is not minimum essential coverage and does not satisfy the requirement for coverage under the Affordable Care Act. 
Coverage is not renewable and does not guarantee coverage of pre-existing conditions unless the optional Pre-Existing Conditions Rider is elected.
Plan Benefits
Pre-Existing Conditions Rider
This coverage generally does not pay benefits for a sickness, injury, pregnancy, or other medical condition that existed before coverage began. This may
include conditions for which you previously:
- received or were advised to receive medical care, consultation, testing, diagnosis, or treatment;
- received a prescription medication; or
- experienced signs or symptoms significant enough that a medical provider could have diagnosed the condition or a reasonable person would have sought
medical care.
Without the optional rider: These limitations are applied separately to each new coverage period. A condition that develops or is treated during an earlier
coverage period may therefore be considered pre-existing under a later Certificate.
With the optional rider: For an additional premium, the rider modifies how the pre-existing-conditions limitation applies after the initial coverage period for
qualifying consecutive coverage purchased together. It does not provide immediate or complete coverage for all pre-existing conditions. State-specific
terms and limitations apply.
See the Certificate and applicable rider for complete details.
Prescription Drugs
The optional Outpatient Prescription Drug Rider provides coverage for eligible generic, preferred brand-name, non-preferred brand-name, and specialty
prescriptions filled through participating pharmacies. It includes a $5,000 maximum benefit per covered person per coverage period. Generic drugs are
subject to a $25 copay, while covered brand-name and specialty drugs are subject to a $500 prescription drug deductible, followed by plan coinsurance.
Prescriptions filled outside the participating pharmacy network are not covered, and coverage is limited to drugs included on the plan’s approved drug list.

Plan Benefits
Pre-Existing Conditions Rider
This coverage generally does not pay benefits for a sickness, injury, pregnancy, or other medical condition that existed before coverage began. This may
include conditions for which you previously:
- received or were advised to receive medical care, consultation, testing, diagnosis, or treatment;
- received a prescription medication; or
- experienced signs or symptoms significant enough that a medical provider could have diagnosed the condition or a reasonable person would have sought
medical care. Without the optional rider: These limitations are applied separately to each new coverage period. A condition that develops or is treated during an earlier
coverage period may therefore be considered pre-existing under a later Certificate. With the optional rider: For an additional premium, the rider modifies how the pre-existing-conditions limitation applies after the initial coverage period for
qualifying consecutive coverage purchased together. It does not provide immediate or complete coverage for all pre-existing conditions. State-specific
terms and limitations apply. See the Certificate and applicable rider for complete details. Prescription Drugs
The optional Outpatient Prescription Drug Rider provides coverage for eligible generic, preferred brand-name, non-preferred brand-name, and specialty
prescriptions filled through participating pharmacies. It includes a $5,000 maximum benefit per covered person per coverage period. Generic drugs are
subject to a $25 copay, while covered brand-name and specialty drugs are subject to a $500 prescription drug deductible, followed by plan coinsurance. Prescriptions filled outside the participating pharmacy network are not covered, and coverage is limited to drugs included on the plan’s approved drug list.
